subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path for Redwood - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap & next steps (procurement path / PO vs card / marketplace)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and I appreciate the clarity on the pilot goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement can move quickly: 

- Pilot scope: 10 concurrent users, non-prod data, 2-week pilot starting when we have access (goal: mid-August).
- Commercial path: two options we commonly support:
  1) Card for immediate pilot (fastest)
  2) PO + contract for production (we support Net30)
- Marketplace: we offer an AWS Marketplace listing if your procurement prefers Marketplace invoicing / consolidated billing — happy to provide Marketplace pricing schedule.

Attaching: Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf and Pricing_Sheet_ACME.xlsx for your review.

Could you confirm:
1) The procurement contact we should loop in (name/email)?
2) Whether ACME requires a PO (Net30) or if card is acceptable to start the pilot?
3) Any vendor onboarding steps (security/finance) we should prepare for?

If helpful I can set up a 15-min weekly check-in to nudge the PO through procurement. Thanks — happy to adapt to whatever process works best.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142
Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf); Pricing_Sheet_ACME.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>

Cc: Samuel Ortiz <samuel.ortiz@acme.com>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps (procurement path / PO vs card / marketplace)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from our side: 

- Procurement typically wants a PO for anything > $5k. Pilot could be on card if we classify as a proof-of-concept, but I'll need to confirm with finance.
- Our procurement team (looped) handles vendor onboarding; they usually require a SOC 2 report and vendor form filled out.
- We're interested in Marketplace if pricing aligns; can you send the Marketplace SKU/pricing?

I expect to have a clearer answer on PO vs card by end of week. For now, please loop in procurement (procurement@acme.com) and include a formal quote so they can start the vendor setup.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Product Manager, ML Platform
Acme Corporation

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps (procurement path / PO vs card / marketplace)

Hi Olivia / Procurement team —

Thanks, and appreciate the quick response. To make things simple:

- For the pilot we can accept card payment immediately (no contract required) — typical approach is card + short pilot SOW.
- If you'd prefer PO/contract for the pilot, we can issue a formal quote and accommodate Net30 terms after vendor onboarding.
- Marketplace: we'll share the AWS Marketplace SKU and pricing in a separate link — it covers consolidated billing but may require additional procurement steps on your side.

Attached is an updated Pricing_Sheet_ACME.xlsx with both card and PO price lines and an estimated SOW. If procurement can start vendor onboarding now (SOC2 + vendor form), we can parallelize the steps and avoid delays.

Would you like a 15-min weekly check-in for the next 2–3 weeks so we can track where the PO is in your process? I can coordinate recurring invites.

Best,
Marissa
Attachments: Pricing_Sheet_ACME.xlsx (updated)

Subject: Re: Quick recap & next steps (procurement path / PO vs card / marketplace)

Hi Marissa / Olivia —

Looping in procurement officially. A few items we need to proceed:

1) Formal quote / quote on your letterhead (total, term, payment terms)
2) SOC 2 Type II evidence (or an attestation link) for vendor security review
3) Vendor setup form (I can send our vendor form once we have the quote)

We prefer Net30 where possible. Please confirm whether Redwood can accept Net30 on the pilot invoice and provide the SOC2 link. Also include a contact for accounts receivable so we can send the PO.

Procurement intake ticket: https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-789

Thanks,
Samuel Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation

We want to keep momentum — planning to offer card for the immediate pilot while procurement completes vendor setup, but procurement needs the items above to start.

—Marissa
